verdict.rationale: Ramp clearly issues cards to employees: virtual cards with per-vendor limits are documented, a hands-on user spins up a new business expense card in under a minute, and the webhooks guide lists card issuance as an event. 'Card swipe' receipt capture implies physical cards, but physical card issuance is never documented directly, and role-based controls are documented only for MCP/API access, not card programs. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of physical card issuance, a debit vs. credit card choice, role-based card issuance and permissions, and independent corroboration of physical card workflows.
